name: chip
title: Chip
summary: A compact item, filter or tag that can be turned on, or removed.
use_when: Filters above a list that turn on and off: ChipToggle
Values the user picked and can take away again: Chip with ChipRemove
avoid_when: One choice from a few options: use Toggle Group or Radio Group

props.label: string: ChipRemove's accessible name, e.g. "Remove Design"

copy.text: One or two words in sentence case

a11y: ChipToggle is a toggle button: screen readers hear it as pressed or not
Name every ChipRemove after its chip: "Remove Design", not "Remove"
